integration: Expose blast_kappa plus existing composition modules; concrete BlastKappaCallbacks implements BlastRedoAlignCallbacks<BlastKappaAlignmentContext>. No shared field changes required.

Native supplies indexed borrowed BlastKappaSubject{sequence_start,length,genetic_code}; sequence_start begins at FIRST NUCLEOTIDE, without a leading sentinel. Subject index and matching-sequence length must correspond to this array. Genetic-code entries are NCBIstdaa.

Native must retain unscaled original scoring/statistical owners, obtain scale32 clone using s_rescale_search, initialize query info/align params, convert preliminary HSP owners, call existing Blast_RedoOneMatch, convert resulting exclusive contexts back into HSPs, evaluate/reap while scores and Lambda are scaled, then normalize scores/bit scores using s_hsp_list_normalize_scores. Original stat/scoring owners are left usable by scoping the scaled copies; no mutation restore machinery is needed.

Set final composition mode2 explicitly using existing option field; s_get_align_params preserves configured mode. Standard non-OOF X-drop path only; PSSM, RPS, out-of-frame, protein-subject fetching and Smith-Waterman callbacks remain outside this supported closure.

s_result_hsp_to_distinct_align transfers HSP owners out of source live-prefix slots; Native must reset source list hspcnt after this transfer before reuse. It must not retain Arc clones of output edit scripts when consuming them via s_hsp_list_from_distinct_alignments.

Final statistics/list evaluation, sum-statistics linking, identities/positives on original unmasked data, heap insertion/early termination and outer database/result orchestration remain Native integration tasks. Existing HSP evaluation/Spouge helpers supply unlinked evaluation; do not claim linking/default pipeline parity from these isolated callback checks.

Matrix interface adapter reconstructs row views from the explicit flat adjusted matrix for the existing dynamic kernel; scratch DP and traceback blocks persist across calls. A future flat-matrix binding can remove these small row copies without altering the translated algorithm.
additional_validation: Three unchanged-C s_DoSegSequenceData cases (diverse/repeated/mixed proteins) match all masked bytes, both sentinels and subject_maybe_biased with original S10/1.8/2.1 parameters.
